traits.label: Hymenium
traits.text: Smooth to slightly glossy, olive-brown, chestnut-brown, becoming darker as it dries
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium: Smooth to slightly glossy, olive-brown, chestnut-brown, becoming darker as it dries

traits.label: Apothecium
traits.text: Deeply cup- or saucer-shaped when young, later spreading, irregularly lobed, undulating or split; outer surface reddish-brown to olivaceous-brown and finely furfuraceous, especially near the margin
traits.raw: ℹ️ Apothecium: Deeply cup- or saucer-shaped when young, later spreading, irregularly lobed, undulating or split; outer surface reddish-brown to olivaceous-brown and finely furfuraceous, especially near the margin

traits.label: Stipe
traits.text: Absent or represented by a very short, inconspicuous basal attachment
traits.raw: ℹ️ Stipe: Absent or represented by a very short, inconspicuous basal attachment

traits.label: Ecology
traits.text: Saprobic on bare, compact, sandy or clay-rich soil in coniferous, deciduous and mixed woodland; often along paths, banks, ditches and disturbed ground; summer to late autumn
traits.raw: 🌲🌳🍂 Saprobic on bare, compact, sandy or clay-rich soil in coniferous, deciduous and mixed woodland; often along paths, banks, ditches and disturbed ground; summer to late autumn

traits.label: Fruit body
traits.text: Fruit body small to medium; approximately 1.5–3.7 cm tall

traits.text: Ascospores ellipsoid, hyaline to faintly yellow-brown, usually biguttulate, ~17–20 × 8–11 µm, asci cylindrical, operculate, amyloid, 8-spored, approximately 300–350 × 12–15 µm; paraphyses cylindrical, septate and slightly enlarged at the apex
